newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Banco Rio plans to issue $1.1 bln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Banco Rio plans to issue $1.1 bln bonds.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Rio de la Plata is planning to issue $1.1 billion in bonds next year, the bank said Tuesday.

The bank's shareholders earlier this month approved the bond program, which is intended to allow Banco Rio to diversify its sources of funds to more adequately meet its clients requirements, Banco Rio said in a statement.
Banco Rio already has outstanding debt issues totaling $850 million in the U.S. and European markets.

It has had several successful placements of U.S. commercial paper, something that "will permit the bank to access stable and less costly sources of financing, facilitating the credit needs of our clients," it said.

In addition to maintaining its traditional business with large firms, Banco Rio is fast building up its portfolio of loans to medium-sized companies. In the fiscal year that ended in June, loans to mid-sized firms rose 43 percent.
